_comment: AIEP GENOME SDK — Mirror Policy. All artefacts are mirrorable. Visibility is governed, not optional.
kernel_rule: All artefacts produced by kernel/ are mirror-compatible by default. Mirror cannot be disabled at kernel level.

PUBLIC.description: Mirror page accessible without authentication. Default for Hub deployments.

PRIVATE.description: Mirror page requires authentication. Default for GENOME SaaS deployments.

SELECTIVE.description: Visibility configured per artefact or page. Requires explicit governance decision per record.

override_rule: Visibility may be changed by enterprise/config only. kernel/ and governance/ layers never change visibility.
first_class_rule: Mirror compatibility is an architectural invariant. It is never bolted on after the fact.
content_hash_binding: Every mirror page content_hash = sha256(canonical_json(data)). This binding is kernel-level and cannot be overridden.
no_additional_facts: Mirror pages must not contain facts not derivable from the human-readable source page (P60).
